title: Neon Dream Cityscape
description: A surreal city skyline composed of glowing green rectangular towers rises from a grid-like tiled ground. The scene is filled with floating translucent bubbles, yellow suns, stars, flowers, and scattered geometric symbols in yellow and purple against a soft pastel background.
prompt: Surreal dreamlike cityscape with glowing translucent green rectangular towers standing on a luminous grid floor. Floating bubbles, yellow suns, stars, flowers, and scattered purple and yellow geometric symbols drift through a soft white and lavender hazy atmosphere. Ethereal glowing highlights and sparkles, pastel color palette, whimsical and magical mood.
